messages:
devon: heads up — we're seeing sustained SLO misses (~p95+p99) for text-gen in us-east over the last 6m. latency graphs show a steady tail even at moderate qps. suspect batching backlog + a regional node drain. :rotating_light:
alert-bot: ALERT: /slo/text-gen/us-east p99 latency > 1200ms for 7m. link: https://grafana.redwood/s/text-gen/slo?panelId=3
aj: checked the batcher metrics — continuous fill on batch_ceiling=64 for small payloads. prefill KV hit rate is low, so GPUs are waiting on batch fill. also one shard in us-east-2 shows high enqueue depth (shard-7).
kevin: confirmed. traffic re-routed after a host drain last night concentrated many low-latency requests to fewer serving nodes. small requests pile up because batch_cooldown isn't aggressive. we hit head-of-line blocking.
maria: quick mitigation options: 1) drop batch_ceiling to 16 for the region temporarily, 2) enable small-payload fast-path (prioritize <200 tokens), 3) route a % of traffic to dedicated warm pool. which do we want to try first?
sarah: option 3 costs money for warm pool. prefer 1+2 as immediate cheap fixes. also document cost impact if we keep warm pool.
aj: patch to lower batch_ceiling in us-east config (will roll canary across 5% nodes):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: batcher-config-us-east
data:
  batch_ceiling: "16"
  small_payload_fastpath: "enabled"
  batch_cooldown_ms: "20"
```
kevin: @maria can you run the rollout? keep canary at 5% then 25 then 100. watch p95/p99 and enqueue depth. set rollback if p99 increases > 20% from baseline.
maria: starting canary now (5% nodes). I'll post metrics after first 2m.
maria: canary done — p95 down ~120ms, p99 down ~350ms, enqueue depth on shard-7 dropped 60%. no obvious cost spike. :thumbsup:
devon: nice. schedule: 25% in 5m, full region in 15m if numbers hold. also open follow-up to model team to add dynamic batch_ceiling by payload histogram.
sarah: created doc in product/ops with cost estimates for warm pool (link: https://docs.redwood/ops/warm-pool-costs).
aj: followups: 1) alert rule for sustained batch_ceiling occupancy > 70% for 5m, 2) circuit-breaker to divert small-payload traffic to fast-path earlier. I'll file tickets.
kevin: also worth adding per-tenant priority so single noisy tenant can't fill big batches.
maria: rolling to 25% now. will report after 5m.
alert-bot: NOTE: deployment event recorded by deploy-bot at 2143650120 by maria — batcher-config-us-east -> batch_ceiling=16
maria: 25% -> p95 down 100ms, p99 down 300ms, enqueue depth steady. proceeding to 100% in 10m.
devon: thanks team. postmortem checklist: root cause = regional host drain -> concentrated low-token traffic + high batch_ceiling -> continuous batching pressure -> H-O-L blocking. mitigations applied: reduced batch_ceiling, enabled small-payload fast-path, follow-up tickets for dynamic batch sizing and per-tenant QoS.
kevin: noting cost tradeoff decision for warm pool in ticket ENGOPS-421.
sarah: will update SLO runbook with temporary mitigation steps.
maria: closing loop once 100% finished. will add graphs to incident thread.
devon: marking as "resolved for now" — reopen if p99 climbs again. Thanks all :heart:
